Regex JIT compiler — compiles regex bytecode to native x86-64 code via DynASM. The generated code is a classic backtracking engine: splits push a resume entry onto an in-memory backtrack stack and all failures unwind through a single fail-entry point.

Imports

wrapper, jit_mem, ../compiler, ../simd

Types

CompiledJit = object
  fn*: RegexJitFn
  ctx*: ptr JitCtx
  codeSize*: int
  firstByte*: int            ## byte the match must start with, -1 = unknown
  anchored*: bool            ## program starts with ^: only startPos 0 can match
JitCtx = object
  stackBase*: ptr UncheckedArray[byte]
  stackLimit*: pointer
RegexJitFn = proc (input: ptr char; inputLen: int; startPos: int;
                   ctx: ptr JitCtx): int {.cdecl.}

Procs

proc compileRegex(prog: Program; fullMatch = false): CompiledJit {.
    ...raises: [KeyError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Compile prog to native code. With fullMatch, opMatch only succeeds at end of input (PCRE fullmatch semantics: failed end checks backtrack into remaining alternatives). Returns a result with fn == nil when the program uses unsupported features (captures) or contains epsilon cycles. 
proc freeJit(cj: var CompiledJit) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Release generated code, backtrack stack and context. 
proc jitExec(cj: CompiledJit; input: string; startPos = 0): int {.inline,
    ...raises: [Exception], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Run the JIT'd matcher anchored at startPos. Returns the match end position, or -1 on no match. 
proc jitScan(cj: CompiledJit; input: string; fromPos = 0): tuple[
    start, stop: int] {....raises: [Exception], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Leftmost scan starting at fromPos: try every start offset until one matches. Returns (-1, -1) when nothing matches.
